summary: Phase 2a end-to-end verified. Backend: 12/12 new pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/test_phase2a.py passed — categories tree (7 top: Rings/Necklaces/Earrings/Bangles/Chains/Anklets/Pendants), create top+sub+delete, referenced-category-delete blocked (400), attributes/for-product Rings returns Ring Size/Gender/Occasion/Certified/Certification Number, dropdown attribute CRUD, metal-types seeded (4), tags CRUD, products enriched with category_name/metal_name/purity_name, filter by category_id & metal_type_id, product create with attribute_values+stone_type_ids persisted, invoice PDF returns application/pdf, starts with %PDF-1., >3KB (~45KB with DejaVu), cashier gets 403 on /categories & /attributes but 200 on /products. Frontend: /catalog loads with 8 left-rail tabs; Attributes tab shows 10 rows; Collections 8; Metals 4. Category create via modal works (UITEST_TopCat appeared in tree). Attribute create modal works (dropdown type with 3 options saved). Product form on /inventory/new: category=Rings→Sub=Solitaire triggers dynamic attribute panel exposing product-attr-ring_size / gender / occasion / certified / cert_no as expected. Product saved and appears in /inventory. POS checkout produces invoice preview with pos-download-pdf-btn — clicking downloads a real PDF (~45KB). Reports page: invoice-pdf-btn-* per row downloads PDFs. Sidebar nav-catalog visible under Commerce. Settings > Permissions matrix shows Catalog module row with 7 action checkboxes for shop_owner (View/Create/Edit/Delete/Export/Import/Manage).

ui_bugs.issue: Missing data-testid='pos-settle-full-btn'. Only 'pos-checkout-btn' has a testid; Settle full is reachable only via text selector.
Individual product cards have no per-card testid — only the container has data-testid='pos-product-grid'. Automated add-to-cart tests must fall back to text match.

product-metal-select and product-purity-select data-testid attributes are missing. Product create still saves but tests cannot set metal/purity via testid; created UITEST_DynRing had no metal/purity chip in inventory list.
Missing data-testid='product-stock-input' — falling back to input[name=stock_qty] which is not present on the controlled inputs, so stock cannot be filled by tests.

issues: Chart renders a large solid black rectangle covering the plot area (visible in dashboard screenshot). Likely an SVG fill color / Bar fill='#000' on missing gradient. Check /app/frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.jsx metal-wise BarChart fill.

React hydration console error: <span> cannot be a child of <option> (Settings.jsx:331). Same pattern as the POS customer-select warning reported in iteration_1 — the JSX inside <option> is being wrapped in a <span> by the tooling. Same warning fires in POS customer select. Cosmetic but noisy.
Recharts still emits width(-1)/height(-1) warnings on mount (unchanged from iteration_1).

action_items: Add data-testid to POS 'Settle full' button (pos-settle-full-btn) and to each product card (pos-product-{id}) in POS.jsx.
Add data-testid on ProductForm.jsx metal type select, purity select, stock qty input.
Fix Dashboard 'Metal-wise revenue this month' chart rendering a black rectangle — check Bar fill/gradient color in the metal-wise BarChart.

Fix <span> inside <option> hydration warning in Settings.jsx (line ~331) — render {u.name} without a wrapping expression that gets a <span> around it. Same fix needed in POS.jsx customer-select (still open from iteration_1).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to 1805 lines. Split into modules (auth, catalog, products, invoices, pdf) to improve maintainability.
PDF endpoint depends on system-installed DejaVu Sans TTF. Consider bundling the font in-repo (backend/fonts/DejaVuSans.ttf) so a fresh container does not lose ₹ glyph if apt-get is not available.
categories delete guard correctly returns 400 when children or product refs exist — good. Verify same guard on metal_types/purities before delete (not tested here).
seed_data_creation: All UITEST_* data (product, attribute, category) created during frontend testing was cleaned up via API at end of run. Invoices AUR-260722-0004 (backend PDF test) and AUR-260722-0005 (frontend POS PDF test) remain and decremented stock on Temple Jhumka.

rca of the issue: N/A – no functional regressions. Only cosmetic issues (dashboard black chart), <span>-in-<option> hydration warnings, and a handful of missing data-testid attributes.
